best_human.evidence_state: published witness transcribed and exactly reproduced
best_human.optimality: best-known construction; no proof of global optimality is claimed

best_public.evidence_state: source reports Solomon/Orrick construction and hosts Gram/decomposition data; task uses the printed sign matrix in Orrick et al.
best_public.origin_type: unknown unless attribution is stated in source/provenance

best_reproduced.evidence_state: independently recomputed by integer Bareiss elimination

baseline_seed.evidence_state: exact determinant; not attributed as a published record

survey_scope_note: Best public means the strongest same-parameter result in the cited checked sources. This is not a claim that every public source has been surveyed. Unmatched parameters are listed separately.
frozen_human_baseline_type: published human witness or explicit construction formula
